title: Admin audit custody manifest and retention attestation
creator: Aisha Banerjee
description: Build a robust audit logging path for admin actions, access events, and configuration changes that produces tamper-evident custody manifests and machine-verifiable retention attestations. The goal is to produce per-tenant evidence bundles suitable for external auditors and regulators (SOC2/ISO/GDPR) while enforcing region-aware retention policies and write-once storage semantics. This work covers event schema changes, in-flight enrichment (before/after snapshots), cryptographic hashing, HSM/KMS stamping, write-once storage integration, and an export/reporting API for evidence retrieval.
acceptance_criteria: All admin actions (console + API) and config changes are captured with user, actor source IP, timestamp, and before/after diffs in the audit stream
Each audit event is assigned a custody manifest entry containing SHA-256 hash, sequence number, region tag, and KMS/HSM signature
Custody manifests are periodically checkpointed into append-only write-once buckets with object-lock retention_mode and customer-residency metadata
Evidence bundles (for a given tenant and time window) can be exported via API as a compressed bundle containing events, manifests, and a Merkle proof file that verifies event inclusion
Retention lifecycle manager respects tenant residency: it prevents deletion until retention expiry and records an attestation file with proof-of-policy enforcement
Automated weekly compliance report is generated and available to auditors with differential summaries (counts of admin actions, retention expirations, and any policy overrides)
All new data paths pass security review and unit + integration tests for signing, verification, and retention enforcement
tasks: Design event enrichment schema with before/after snapshots and compact diff format
Add custody_manifest fields to audit event proto and streaming pipeline
Integrate with KMS/HSM to produce per-checkpoint signatures and store signer metadata
Implement write-once retention writer using cloud object-lock + immutable flag and region metadata
Build merkle-tree aggregator service that creates periodic checkpoints and lightweight proofs
Create evidence-export API that accepts tenant ID, time range, and produces signed bundle with verification instructions
Implement retention-lifecycle manager to enforce deletion holds and emit attestation records when retention policy expires
Add observability: per-tenant audit ingestion lag, missing-signature alerts, export success/failure metrics
Add end-to-end tests including simulated cross-region failover and offline KMS scenarios
Document auditor playbook and retention verification steps in Confluence
notes: Security requirement: proof files must be verifiable without contacting internal services; include public key fingerprints and signer timestamps
Trade-off: storing before/after snapshots increases storage; use compact JSON diff for common object schemas and sample full snapshots for high-risk changes
We must support per-tenant residency: when a tenant is region-locked, all evidence bundles must be produced from region-local storage or escorted export with customer approval
Design decision: use SHA-256 for leaf hashes and a canonical JSON serialization to avoid cross-language diffs
Consideration: allow a secondary offline notarization step for long-term archives (arxiv-style durable attestations) via partner escrow if customer requests multi-decade proof
Operational concern: retention enforcement must be idempotent and survive controller restarts; use idempotent checkpoint tokens stored in the manifest index
